text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.5.6

      - name: Initialize Terraform
        run: terraform init

      - name: Plan Terraform changes
        id: terraform_plan
        run: terraform plan -out=tfplan

      - name: Check for "open" changes in the plan
        run: |
          PLAN=$(cat ${{ steps.terraform_plan.outputs.plan_file }})
          if echo "$PLAN" | grep -q 'open'; then
            echo "::error::Terraform plan contains 'open' changes which are not parsed properly."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Comment on PR with Terraform plan
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          COMMENT="## Terraform Plan\n\`\`\`\n$(cat tfplan)\n\`\`\`"
          gh pr comment ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --body "$COMMENT"

      - name: Set up GitHub App token
        id: octo_sts
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: api.github.com
          scope: repo
          policy: '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["repo"]}]}'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: grafana/shared-workflows/actions/dockerhub-login@dockerhub-login/v1.0.2

      - name: First interaction with GitHub
        uses: actions/first-interaction@v3
        with:
          issue_message: "Thank you for opening an issue! We're here to help."
          pr_message: "Thank you for opening a pull request! We're here to review it."
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
